name: Tarek
notes: Respects him. Frustrated by his secrecy. Believes Tarek knows more than he admits.

name: Luma
notes: Closest person in his life. Often confides in her.

name: Nara
notes: Respects her wisdom. Questions many of her teachings.

name: Ren
notes: One of the few villagers he finds genuinely interesting. Sometimes helps him investigate ruins.

name: Elira
notes: Most villagers avoid her. Ikan does not.
